LightningComponentBundle.description: A button that downloads Salesforce data as Excel workbooks or CSV files, one table per Data_Export_Sheet__mdt record of the chosen Data_Export__mdt.

property.name: exportName
property.label: Export
property.description: Developer name of the Data Export (Data_Export__mdt) to download. On a record page, sheet filters can use :recordId for this record.

property.name: formats
property.label: Formats
property.description: both: the button is a menu of Excel and CSV. excel or csv: a single button for that format.

property.name: label
property.label: Button label
property.description: Defaults to Export, or Export to Excel / Export to CSV when one format is offered.

property.name: variant
property.label: Button variant
property.description: Applies to the single-format button. The format menu is always neutral.
